description_en: Modifies the DNS servers used by a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-user-dns --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagUserDns

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the primary DNS server.

If you do not set this parameter, the IP address of the existing DNS server will be cleared
parameters.help_zh:
主DNS服务器IP地址。

不设置会清空DNS配置
parameters.name: master_dns

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the secondary DNS server.

If you do not set this parameter, the IP address of the existing DNS server will be cleared
parameters.help_zh:
备DNS服务器IP地址。

不设置会清空备用DNS配置
parameters.name: slave_dns
